name: Boon of Revelry

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Otto's Irresistible Dance is always prepared with a free casting each Long Rest; you cast it without components, damage can't break your Concentration on it, and its dancers can't cast Verbal spells.

benefits.name: Irresistible Revelry
benefits.summary: Otto's Irresistible Dance is always prepared, with one free casting per Long Rest.
benefits.text: You always have Otto's Irresistible Dance prepared, using the ability this boon increased. You can cast it once without a spell slot, regaining that casting when you finish a Long Rest, and you can also cast it with slots.

benefits.name: Endless Dance
benefits.summary: No components; damage can't break your Concentration on it; a creature it Charms can't cast Verbal spells.
benefits.text: You cast Otto's Irresistible Dance without components, and taking damage can't break your Concentration on it. A creature Charmed by your casting of it can't cast spells with a Verbal component, and sings nonsense if it can.
